LanguageData.FatReserve_SettingDefaultStateDesc: Determines the initial fattening state (ON or OFF) for all animals that are newly born, purchased from traders, or encountered by the mod for the first time.
LanguageData.FatReserve_SettingStorageModeDesc: Determines how the player-toggled mode is saved for a specific animal. "Map" binds the setting to the location, and the setting resets when changing locations. "Animal" embeds the setting directly into the creature itself.
LanguageData.FatReserve_GizmoDesc_DiffFromGlobalTempl: \nDoes not match current default behavior for new animals.
LanguageData.FatReserve_GizmoDesc_DiffFromRaceTemplat: \nDoes not match current default behavior for new animals of the {0} breed.

LanguageData.FatReserve_MenuRaceMapOff_Prefix: Disable fat reserve for breed on current map:
LanguageData.FatReserve_MenuRaceGlobalOn_Prefix: Enable fat reserve for breed globally:

LanguageData.FatReserve_MenuRaceDefaultOff_Prefix: Disable default fattening for new animals of breed:
